Bus Simulator 27 – Update 1.20 🚌
We just published Update 1.20 including a number of additional fixes and game improvements.
Multiplayer
Fixed the player falling through the map in multiplayer.
Fixed resetting traffic despawning the bus from the dealership in multiplayer.
Traffic AI
Fixed the curb penalty being incorrectly applied near the Old Manor landmark in Eternal City, and invisible curbs at specific locations in Serene Mountains.
Fixed multiple spots in Iron District where the player could fall through rails or stairs.
Fixed an AI bus hitting a street lamp when entering a bus station and then stopping in New Harbour.
Fixed servicing Northside Car Park A then Factory Offices B forcing the player to cross a continuous line.
Gameplay / UI
When a livery is already applied to the current bus, the UI now shows "Apply to all" instead of "Apply".
Bus Customization: garage camera logic improvements.
Bus Customization: patterns and colors rework update.
Fixed the player being blocked from progressing in Humble Beginnings.
Fixed the main lights mode icons on the HUD not matching the icons in the shortcut menu.
Fixed the "Proper speed" score appearing even when the Speeding penalty is set to Off.
Fixed the retarder being marked as unavailable in the shortcut menu on some bus models despite working.
Bus Showcase: fixed the bus computer being placed under the bus after selecting the same bus twice.
Fixed the blinker / turn signal turning off automatically too early.
Fixed existing bus lines not being shown on the map when opening the bus lines management tab.
Fixed the button prompts being too close together when interacting with landmark plaques; they now line up with other pop-ups.
Fixed passengers moving while stuck in a sitting position after exiting a bus.
Fixed the "Check ticket" action and the Vehicle Shortcut menu being operated from the same button.
Fixed the Career Mode Congratulations screen looping until the on-screen keys stopped responding, requiring a restart.
Addressed player reports that the turn signal on the GUI breaks immersion in first-person view.
Join Trip fixes: it no longer fails to teleport the player to the bus in most of New Quarter District, or spawns the player outside the bus.
Fixed inconsistent behavior of the bottom bar, plus a double-click issue on the Create Character tile in the main menu.
Vehicle / Art
Fixed incorrect side light behavior, including on locked buses.
Fixed passenger seats on the Iveco Urbanway 18 and Alexander Dennis Enviro 500EV.
Lighting fixes: interior light setup, passenger lights on the Citaro G, and further light adjustments across buses.
A number of smaller adjustments on different buses.
Localization
Additional localization fixes.
Audio
Adjusted the blinker sounds.
We wish you a lot of fun playing!
Your Bus Simulator team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702235/94f5fa866a300724d8c5a0df879347e6237746d6.jpg"]

We just published Update 1.19 introducing the option to continue a route after an Extra Trip got completed, improved AI bus schedules, improved GPS line behaviour, some passenger animation improvements, temperature control fixes and a number of other fixes and game improvements.
Critical Fixes
Fixed a crash when attempting to start an Extra Trip.
Fixed a crash when switching between DLSS Frame Generation and AMD FSR Frame Generation; only one frame generator is now active per session.
Quality of Life Improvements
Seamless service: Continue Trip after an Extra Trip keeps the bus in place and guides the player to the first stop of the next route.
Multiplayer
Fixed the GPS not updating for the client during multiplayer sessions.
Traffic AI
Improved AI buses schedule
The turn signal penalty system is now turned off by default.
NPC vehicles now fade out when despawning instead of disappearing abruptly.
Mesh sequence contraction in paths.
Fixed stop lines at the remaining junctions.
Gameplay / UI
Improved GPS lines behavior
Fixed an event triggering immediately after starting a manual line service.
Trip Summary: fixed the Company XP reward counter overlapping the company level, and 100% Punctuality and Traffic discipline being displayed incorrectly.
Passenger animation updates, including an adjusted problematic seat position.
Fixed passenger heads clipping on bus back seats.
Fixed the Delete This Line option in Bus Lines disappearing when moving the map with a controller; it's now hidden once a line has been deleted.
Fixed the great stop position score being earnable infinitely by opening the doors with the engine off.
Fixed ghost buses standing on their routes without a driver, showing "out of service" and blocking traffic, including the buses on Rafael's four lines in the Full Circle story mission.
Fixed the player being able to highlight subsection titles in all bindings settings.
Redesigned the Landmark icons.
Vehicle / Art
Temperature control fixes: automatic temperature control no longer turns on the AC in winter, and AC/heating restarts after the bus power is turned off and back on.
Corrected the rear lights on the Setra S417.
Glass reflections visual update.
Audio
Fixed the announcement treating the first stop as the "last stop" when servicing a loop line from the bus depot.
Updated occlusion and reverb for stop request sounds.
Note: If you like the game and didn't do so yet...we are looking forward to your reviews!
Your Bus Simulator team
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702235/d0d73b0f1a09c45a86e8731a80e18aa9390ef45c.jpg"]
Bus Simulator 27 – Update 1.18 🚌
We just published Update 1.18 introducing Italian and Brazilian Portuguese language support, as well as a number of traffic AI and other game improvements and fixes.
Support for Italian language ingame texts added.
Support for Brazilian Portuguese language ingame texts added.
(Note: More languages to come)
Fixed a game crash caused by passengers re-entering the bus after being thrown out.
Fixed the game freezing on a PS5 host after a few minutes of multiplayer gameplay.
Fixed issues caused by Daylight Saving Time that made AI bus drivers wait at bus stops so their schedule would match the current time.
Added a connection quality warning that notifies a client when their connection is affecting gameplay.
Fixed the client being unable to begin a trip from the bus depot.
Fixed clients being kicked out of multiplayer sessions on join, and a black screen with no functionality when teleporting to a bus.
Fixed the GPS not plotting a route for the client when starting an Extra Trip from a bus depot.
Further fixes for junctions in Fishermen's Wharf, New Harbour, Iron District, Peace District and Worker's Town.
Level design fixes: unserviceable Crude Oil Tanks stops, stop highlights at Refining Hub A and Lighthouse Road A, and traffic AI in Lake Valley.
Added contextual Bus Control Hints for ending a service at the bus depot.
Fixed the player getting stuck in the seat in the Alexander Dennis Enviro500, and NPC and player heads clipping through the roof in various models.
Character Creation: removed white row outlines, keeping only category separators.
Fixed the line name overlapping the line rating in the Employees tab.
Fixed the controller vibrating when driving over a crossing.
Fixed passengers crouching while sitting.
Fixed the names of new customization presets not being changeable.
Removed conflicting keybinds from the bus showcase, which stopped the shortcut menu opening with a gamepad on Alternative bindings.
Fixed vibration/force feedback missing from the Shortcut menu when cycling fast through the ignition options.
Changing the main event frequency option in World & Company Settings now changes all related options as well.
Fixed two NPCs being able to sit on the same seat.

GPS fixes: it no longer tells the player to turn around instead of offering alternative routes, now directs the player forward to a stop behind them, and no longer redirects them in the opposite direction.
Fixed a redundant missing-DLC message after loading a save from version 1.17 or older.
Fixed the fleet number decal being misplaced and detached from the body on the Ebusco Articulated and Setra S518.
Fixed one of the headlights on the Scania Citywide LF 12M not working properly.
Fixed the rearmost passenger lights not being visible in several models.
AC and heating now turn off when the bus is powered off.
Fixed warning lights staying on.
Fixes to minor visual and collision issues in the game world.
Fixed the ticket computer collider on the Alexander Dennis Enviro 500, which required clicking a specific spot to buy an A+RUL ticket.
Fixed the daytime running light looking incorrect on the Solaris Urbino.
Fixed NPC drivers with floating hair, caused by scale being wrongly forwarded from the bus to the driver's skeletal mesh bones.
Fixed an FPS dip at the Terrace Drive A station in High Town by bringing resolution quality (used when dynamic resolution is off) to sane levels.
Ensured that stop request sounds play correctly in all buses.
General improvements to bus sounds and the sound system overall
Your Bus Simulator team

topNew: Support for Italian language ingame texts added.
Support for Brazilian Portuguese language ingame texts added.

Bus Simulator 27 – Update 1.17 🚌
We just released Update 1.17 introducing Stop Requests, the option to start a drive from the depot as well as some additional game improvements.
Critical Fixes
Fix for Xbox crash related to changes in player settings.
Fixed a crash when colliding with a pedestrian.
Fixed Xbox Series OOM crashes related to loading fonts.
Quality of Life Improvements
Passengers can now request a stop. You'll hear a signal when someone wants to get off at the next stop.
You can now start an Extra Trip from the nearest bus depot.
Multiplayer
Numerous multiplayer fixes, including rubberbanding while driving, pedestrian and UI desyncs, and AI driver behaviour.
Traffic AI
Improvements to workflow on junctions in Station District, Villa Urbana, Grand Promenade, High Coast and Iron District.
Fixed buses being unable to turn left when leaving the Lower Bus Terminal in Station District from platforms A–D.
Various level design fixes to junctions, and duplicated road signs that collided and fell over without player contact.
Gameplay / UI
Fixed NPCs being stuck in various places in the Blue Bird Sigma, Citaro G and other bus models.
Fixed the player sliding out of the bus after checking tickets in the MAN Lion's City 18.
Fixed the player getting stuck behind opened bus doors.
Fixed the player being incorrectly teleported after finishing the Humble Beginnings quest, caused by a teleport lock on mission change.
The player is now informed that the character name can't be edited after creation.
Fixed the game freezing when first opening the character customisation colour menu.
Shortcut Menu icons are now highlighted based on Bus Control Hints.
The player report button in the Bus Lines widget is now hidden in single-player, where there are no other players to report.
Fixed bus line ratings showing N/A for older lines when new lines are created.
Fixed the HUD stop countdown not switching from arrival to departure after opening the doors when servicing a line.
Fixed the time to next stop always showing 0 on the trip summary screen.
Added a missing story dialogue for the VIP Transport mission.
Fixed goals in the "All Good Things" mission desynchronizing if the player didn't log in to the bus computer.
Fixed the "All Good Things" cinematic potentially blocking the player character.
Vehicle / Art
Fixed the dashboard screen flickering before startup on the Safra model.

Level art bugfixes: the bus getting stuck on a tilted road, passengers floating at a bus stop spawn point, and fences missing collision in the Coast area, plus missing spline colliders and some polish in the industrial area.

More level art bugfixes: an invisible bus collision near Coral Estate B, excessive cliff colliders blocking the path in High Town, floating NPCs in the Coast bus stop area, and overly long fence splines in the rural area.
Door collider rotation pass.
Localization
Fixed a German preset name being over 15 characters long.
More fixes to Polish translations of story tasks.
Added missing strings for bus depot and bus stop passenger demand.
Audio
Implemented the bus retarder sounds.
Sound occlusion changes and updates.
Platform
Fixed the Epic Games Store DLC ownership check, which kept Deluxe content from unlocking on Epic.
Your Bus Simulator team

Bus Simulator 27 – Update 1.16 🚌

Critical Fixes
Fixed most occurring crashes related to NPCs.
Multiplayer
Fixed issues with the client not being updated in real time on the employee panel and bus routes.
Now the "Back To Square One" quest does not disappear for the client.
Fixed a character model disappearing after being hit by a bus.
Traffic AI
Fixed lines on an intersection not being respected by traffic.
Next batch of improvements to traffic overall — you should now see fewer deadlocks, rear-end collisions and flying cars.
Old Town district road junctions should be smoother now.
Gameplay / UI
Fixed issues with predefined lines, buses, and employees when restarting or cancelling the Full Circle mission.
Fixed the player being unable to move after using "leave trip" in the Mercedes Intouro.
Fixed inconsistent spacing in button prompts and added missing safe zones to the bus customisation and player customisation screens.
Styling and handheld-specific fixes in the HUD Bus Computer.
Fixed the LED panel not updating properly when changing display text in bus line settings.

Removed an unnecessary free Solaris 12 bus given to players during the Tourist storyline.

Fixed the bus creeping after leaving a trip despite the parking brake being on.
Fixed the character thumbnail in Character Creation sometimes appearing black.
Fixed a frame limit change in the options not being reflected visually after saving.
Fixed the intercity line's return-route Extra Trip starting far behind the schedule.
To keep gameplay smooth, we introduced a system for despawning stuck passengers.
Enabled scrolling on multiplayer filter labels when text exceeds the width of the container.
Now save files can be added to the in-game report tool.
Vehicle / Art
Fixed several Art bugs: floating litter at the bus terminal, invisible colliders in various locations, and floating environment assets in various locations.
Fixed battery charge on electric buses resetting when the player starts driving.
Localization
Fixed one missing page in the German-language tutorial.
Minor fixes to German and Polish localization.
Fixed Polish diacritics not displaying correctly for NPC driver names.
Audio
Now the proper ambient sound should be played after loading a save in rural areas.
Matched EV ignition delay to startup sound length across electric buses.
More updates will follow!
Your Bus Simulator team

releases.displayName: Update: DLSS & FSR support available now!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702235/62ae9172285c9e23d996a0ba5fcc883c4da0706c.jpg"]
We just released a new update for the Bus Simulator 27 Demo, including some general game improvements and adding support for NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR.

NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR were originally planned for the main game release, but after reading your feedback during Steam Next Fest, we decided to bring them forward right now. Performance has been one of the most discussed topics around the demo, so the team accelerated development and managed to include DLSS and FSR in today’s update, ready for the second half of Steam Next Fest.

DLSS and FSR can help to improve the framerate by using modern upscaling technology. On supported hardware, this allows the game to render more efficiently while still aiming to keep image quality high. Depending on your hardware and selected settings, these options may also offer additional features such as frame generation.

This update is an important step for us, but it is not the end of our work. We are continuing to review your feedback, monitor performance reports, and prepare further improvements for the demo and the full release.

Thanks to everyone who has played the demo, shared feedback, reported issues, and helping us to improve the experience. Please try the new graphics options and let us know how they perform on your system.
Added NVIDIA DLSS and AMD FSR support.
Reduced repeated story voice lines in City and Intercity missions.
Improved Logitech G923 Xbox steering wheel support.
Fixed inconsistent speed limit changes
Some smaller fixes and improvements
See you on the road!
Your Bus Simulator team
